title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)

messages.subject: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to present our competitive quote for your requirements. Our price is €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: part:370010 – price basis 2027 with a 24/36-month commitment
messages.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your offer. We propose a longer commitment in exchange for a price that reflects recent cost movements.

AS-14404 fell from 3182.6744 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06) to 3007.8019 (idx:AS-14404@2026-09), a change of -5.49 %.
PPI-C2431 fell from 131.9 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-05) to 129.1 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08), a change of -2.12 %.
Our forecast for this part records a volume change of 1.9 % (fc:370010@2026-09).

The attached term sheets cover 23,700 kg per year over 24 or 36 months, at fixed prices with no index clause. As this exceeds 2 %, please submit it to your pricing committee for review. Could you also tell us your earliest lead time and whether a cheaper bar variant would suit?

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.subject: Re: part:370010 – price basis 2027 with a 24/36-month commitment
messages.body:
Dear customer,
Thank you very much for your message - it is always a pleasure to hear from you, and we are glad to help wherever we can.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €5.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.
Here is the background.
We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains.
LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains.
PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains.
We acknowledge the recent decreases in AS-14404 and PPI-C2431, which we have factored into our revised calculation.
While we welcome a 36-month commitment, we cannot offer fixed prices for this duration and must include an AS-14404 index clause.
To support this reduced price of €5.50, we require payment terms to remain at 30 days net.
Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net: €5.40 per unit.
From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 0.24 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.05 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.03 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision.
We look forward to doing good business together, and our team is always there for you.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

Logistics: Please note that our standard Lieferzeit is 14 days, as we currently have free capacity for your parts. With overtime we can also deliver in 14 days, though this option comes at a premium.

messages.subject: Part 370010 - revised term sheets for 36-month commitment
messages.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for confirming the index and volume data and for the revised offer.

Your 2026Q3 scorecard shows on-time delivery of 81.0 % (sc:70740@2026Q3), below what we expect from an A-class source.

The attached term sheets commit 23,700 kg per year for 36 months. One option has fixed prices. The other uses your proposed AS-14404 clause with a 5 % deadband, so both sides share index movements fairly. As the change exceeds 2 %, we kindly ask that your pricing committee review it.

Your owner offered to walk us through the material and hourly-rate calculation. We would welcome that. Is a cheaper bar variant possible?

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.subject: Re: Part 370010 - revised term sheets for 36-month commitment
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have verified the delivery performance data you cited and have factored it into our revised calculation. Building on your second term sheet, we accept the 36-month commitment with the AS-14404 index clause and 90-day payment terms, reducing our price to €5.40 per unit.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our Angebot is valid for 7 days.

Our current offer is a price of €5.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 0.24 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.05 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.03 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision.

We would be pleased to schedule a meeting to walk through the cost breakdown and explore cheaper technical variants.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

Logistics: Please note that our standard Lieferzeit is 14 days, as we currently have free capacity for your parts. With overtime we can also deliver in 14 days, though this option comes at a premium.
